import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# Data
conditions = ['Exec-only', 'ISR s42', 'ISR s43', 'ISR s44', 'Random', 'SFT']
H7  = [0,    16.0, 96.7, 86.5, 0,    0]
H1  = [87.1, 51.9, 0,    0,    81.3, 7.1]
H3  = [0,    0,    0,    0,    1.3,  0]
Gen = [12.9, 30.9, 3.3,  13.5, 18.7, 92.9]

colors = {
    'H7': '#D55E00',
    'H1': '#E69F00',
    'H3': '#F0E442',
    'Genuine': '#009E73',
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

x = np.arange(len(conditions))
width = 0.55

# Stack bottom-up: H7, H1, H3, Genuine
bottoms = np.zeros(len(conditions))
for vals, label, color in [
    (H7, 'H7: Conclusion duplication', colors['H7']),
    (H1, 'H1: Conclusion embedding', colors['H1']),
    (H3, 'H3: Complexity w/o utility', colors['H3']),
    (Gen, 'Genuine', colors['Genuine']),
]:
    bars = ax.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, color=color, label=label, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # Label segments >= 5%
    for i, (v, b) in enumerate(zip(vals, bottoms)):
        if v >= 5:
            ax.text(x[i], b + v / 2, f'{v:.0f}%' if v == int(v) else f'{v:.1f}%',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='medium',
                    color='white' if color in ['#D55E00', '#009E73'] else 'black')
    bottoms += np.array(vals)

# Axes
ax.set_ylabel('Percentage of Proved Samples (%)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 115)
ax.set_yticks(range(0, 101, 20))
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(conditions, fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)

# Remove top/right spines
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Group bracket for ISR s42/s43/s44
bracket_y = 104
ax.annotate('', xy=(0.7, bracket_y), xytext=(3.3, bracket_y),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=1.2, color='#333333'),
            annotation_clip=False)
# Vertical ticks at ends
for bx in [0.7, 3.3]:
    ax.plot([bx, bx], [bracket_y - 1.5, bracket_y], color='#333333', lw=1.2, clip_on=False)
ax.text(2.0, bracket_y + 2, r'ISR $\beta$=0.1', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color='#333333')

# Legend at bottom, horizontal
ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.10), ncol=4, fontsize=9,
          frameon=False, handlelength=1.2, handletextpad=0.4, columnspacing=1.0)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.06, 1, 1])

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_3/projects/solver-trace-ablation/paper/figures/fig3_hacking_composition.pdf'
fig.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {out}')
PYEOF
